historical.scope: Recorded one-GPU actions, original unprotected resident offered load, frozen source; local endpoint and training-only tail adapters. Loaded/long gates are existing gates; policy limits preserve analytic-reference error. Transferred-tail failures remain visible. This validates engine progress, not protected serving, moving trajectories, fleet SLOs or new policy decisions.

regional_execution.scope: Previously inspected regional partition; fixed actions, frozen context and resident load. Tests engine transport/compute, not source growth, dynamic serving admission or fleet-scale fidelity.

scope: Numerical refinement and original hardware contracts; not proof of fleet SLOs, global controller optimality, or planning-grid independence. Parallel worker timings include concurrent contention. Candidate positive network releases and downstream phases use causal bin boundaries; within-bin residual endpoint windows and changed sharing remain approximations. Isolated-fastest rankings retain raw singleton times. Every wave captures last completed source state at first dispatch. coding_long starts at >=24576 tokens but cycles full recorded trajectories, including resets to shorter contexts. Use actual transferred bytes; initial-state payload is not a dynamic-campaign lower bound. Any context above16384 switches its entire replay batch to conservative serial work; the long-batch calibration supports that family, not a physical discontinuity at the threshold.
